<!-- release-notes-for: 1.1.10 -->
<!-- One "- **Title**: description" line per change. The in-app updater shows each as a card. Update the marker above to the new versionName in every release PR. -->
- **💰 No more false ৳0.00**: If your balances can't be loaded, TakaFlow shows your last saved balances, or says it can't load them, instead of showing zero.
- **👛 Add spending to a brand-new wallet**: Transactions for a wallet that hasn't synced yet are saved and sent right after the wallet, with no error.
- **🔄 Sync now means now**: Tapping the sync badge restarts the retry timer, so you don't wait minutes for the next try.
